datasets.title: UK N-1 Contingency Map
datasets.description: Pre-computed N-1 outage impact for every primary substation in GB. For each primary we enumerate every credible upstream line / transformer outage, flag downstream feeders that would exceed 100% thermal rating, estimate BSC P2/7 restoration time (15 min urban / 60 min rural), and return a 0-100 reliability score.
datasets.returns: Substation, reliability score (0-100), worst-case overload %, affected MW, per-outage events, restoration path

datasets.title: NESO TEC Register
datasets.description: Transmission Entry Capacity register. Every in-queue and accepted transmission project with POC substation, MW, stage, commissioning year.
datasets.returns: Project, MW, POC, stage, commissioning year

datasets.title: DNO Capacity Maps — UKPN/NPG/NGED/SPEN/ENWL/SSEN
datasets.description: Unified headroom + ECR feed across all six GB DNO open-data portals. Substation, voltage, firm/reverse headroom, embedded capacity register rows.
datasets.returns: Substation, voltage, headroom (MW), ECR row, constraint

datasets.title: HM Land Registry INSPIRE Polygons
datasets.description: Cadastral parcel polygons for every freehold + leasehold title in England & Wales. Joins to CCOD/OCOD for ownership attribution.
datasets.returns: Parcel polygon, INSPIRE id, title number

datasets.title: HSE COMAH + BESS Safety
datasets.description: HSE Control of Major Accident Hazards guidance + BESS-specific alerts and technical bulletins. Consulted on planning + fire authority sign-off.
datasets.returns: Guidance, alert, technical bulletin

datasets.title: EU EED Article 12 — DC Reporting
datasets.description: Energy Efficiency Directive Article 12 annual data-centre reporting (IT load >= 500 kW). PUE, WUE, ERF, REF, water source, waste-heat use.
datasets.returns: Annual DC report with energy + water metrics

datasets.title: REPD — Renewable Energy Planning Database
datasets.description: DESNZ monthly extract of every UK renewable + storage project through planning. Outcome, capacity, technology, decision date.
datasets.returns: Project, MW, technology, status, decision date

datasets.title: PINS NSIP Register
datasets.description: Planning Inspectorate register of every Nationally Significant Infrastructure Project DCO — generation > 50 MW, major transmission, gas, rail.
datasets.returns: Application, examination milestone, decision

datasets.title: Ofgem Publications + Decisions
datasets.description: Every Ofgem publication — RIIO-T3, RIIO-ED2/ED3, REMA, MSIP, connection charging, licence modifications, compliance notices.
datasets.returns: Decision, consultation, open letter, framework doc

datasets.title: BMRS Balancing Mechanism
datasets.description: Elexon BMRS balancing mechanism — MEL, PN, BOA accepts, system prices, imbalance volumes, settlement runs at 15-minute resolution.
datasets.returns: Settlement period, BM unit, volume, price

datasets.title: LCCC CfD Allocation Round 7
datasets.description: Low Carbon Contracts Company allocation round 7 — budget, pot allocation, reference prices, agreement signings, CfD contract register.
datasets.returns: Contract, strike price, MW, delivery year

datasets.title: Capacity Market Auction Results
datasets.description: T-1 and T-4 Capacity Market auction outcomes — successful CMUs, clearing price, derated capacity, agreement type, delivery year.
datasets.returns: CMU, clearing price (£/kW), derated MW, delivery year

datasets.title: NESO FES 4-Pathway Scenarios
datasets.description: Future Energy Scenarios — Leading the Way, Consumer Transformation, System Transformation, Falling Short. Demand, generation and network projections 2025-2050.
datasets.returns: Scenario, year, metric, value

datasets.title: Companies House SPV Filings
datasets.description: Daily diff of SPV incorporations, charges, PSC changes and accounts filings across UK renewable + storage developers.
datasets.returns: Company, event type, date, filing reference

datasets.title: Find-a-Tender Energy Notices
datasets.description: UK Find-a-Tender notices filtered to energy + grid CPV codes. Contract opportunity, award and modification notices across public procurement.
datasets.returns: Notice, buyer, value, CPV, deadline

datasets.title: NESO Balancing Services Monthly
datasets.description: NESO monthly balancing services report — constraint cost, reserve volumes, frequency response, dispatch, system operator action log.
datasets.returns: Month, service, volume, cost

datasets.title: Ofgem RIIO-ED2/ED3 Register
datasets.description: Ofgem price control decisions for distribution (ED2 in delivery, ED3 in development) — cost allowances, MVS, uncertainty mechanisms, LRE.
datasets.returns: Decision, allowance, DNO, effective date

datasets.title: EA Flood Map for Planning
datasets.description: Statutory flood zones 2 + 3 with climate-change overlay — a hard planning exclusion for NSIP DCOs and Town & Country Planning applications. OGL v3 via the Defra Spatial Data WFS.
datasets.returns: Zone class, climate scenario, area ha, geometry

datasets.title: LCCC CfD Daily Reference Price
datasets.description: Low Carbon Contracts Company daily IMRP + BMRP + CfD top-up payments. Defines CfD cashflow for every AR-awarded solar, wind, and storage project.
datasets.returns: Trading date, series, price £/MWh

datasets.title: MoD DIO Safeguarding Zones
datasets.description: MoD Defence Infrastructure Organisation safeguarded sites — low-flying zones, radar lines of sight, explosive storage cordons, training areas. Consulted on every wind/tall-structure application per ODPM Circular 01/2003.
datasets.returns: Zone type, buffer m, statutory basis, geometry

datasets.title: CAA Aerodrome Safeguarding
datasets.description: Civil Aviation Authority aerodrome safeguarding surfaces (CAP 738) — obstacle limitation surfaces, wind-turbine exclusion radii, glint-glare buffers, public safety zones. Hard consult for any project >50 m AGL.
datasets.returns: Aerodrome, ICAO, zone class, height limit m, geometry
